## Early life
Usher Raymond IV[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-PeopleBio-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-5) was born on October 14, 1978,[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-6) in [Dallas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dallas "Dallas"), Texas.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-swe-7) His parents are [Jonnetta Patton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonnetta_Patton "Jonnetta Patton") ([née](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%A9e "Née") O'Neal) and Usher Raymond III.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_\(musician\)#cite_note-9) He spent the majority of his childhood in [Chattanooga, Tennessee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chattanooga,_Tennessee "Chattanooga, Tennessee").
